title: Limit Mace Crafting
description: Limit how many maces can be crafted—balance your world.
body:
## Limit Mace Crafting ⚒️

Control how many maces can be crafted in your world.

Set a global limit from **1–50**.  
Once the limit is reached, crafting is automatically disabled ❌

---

### Features
• Configurable limit (1–50)  
• Auto-disable crafting at max limit  
• Lightweight & server-friendly  
• Ideal for SMP, PvP & RPG 🎮  


### How it works
Each crafted mace adds to a global counter.  
Hit the limit → crafting is blocked 🚫

---

### Use cases
• Balanced progression ⚖️  
• Rare weapon systems  
• Better server control  


**Power has limits. Use it wisely...**
